description: Evaluation set for fixtures/vault. Each query lists the notes a good search should return. Superseded memories are never counted as relevant, so ranking that demotes them scores higher. Judgments were written by hand for a synthetic vault; the numbers indicate direction, not production quality. The last 15 queries were added after the first 33 put both tokenizers at the ceiling: they probe parts of longer words and whole questions as people and agents ask them.
